item.title: ZSCMST Muslim Students’ Association Holds Grand Iftar 2026
item.description: The Muslim Students’ Association of the Zamboanga State College of Marine Sciences and Technology spearheaded a Grand Iftar on March 12, 2026, at the ZSCMST Open Grounds. The activity brought together our Muslim brothers and sisters in the spirit of Ramadan, fostering unity, reflection, and fellowship while strengthening the sense of community within the institution.
